Delete Your Account

You can delete your Skootlink account at any time. This page explains how and what happens to your data.

⚠️ This action is permanent Account deletion cannot be undone. Please read the information below before proceeding.

📱 Option 1 — Delete from the app

  1. Open the Skootlink app and sign in to your account

  2. Tap the profile icon in the top-right corner of the screen

  3. Go to Settings

  4. Tap the Security tab

  5. Scroll down to Delete Account and tap it

  6. Enter your password to confirm, then tap Delete My Account

✉️ Option 2 — Request via email

If you cannot access the app, send a deletion request to our support team from your registered email address.

Email us from your registered Skootlink email address

Send Deletion Request

We will process your request within 7 business days and confirm by email.

🗑️ What happens to your data

Data type Action Retention
Profile (name, email, phone, location) Deleted immediately None
Profile photo / avatar Deleted immediately None
Chat messages Deleted immediately None
Vehicle listings Deleted immediately None
ID / licence verification documents Deleted immediately None
Rental agreements / contracts Retained temporarily 90 days (financial compliance)
Credit transaction history Retained temporarily 90 days (financial compliance)

After 90 days, all remaining data is permanently and irreversibly deleted from our systems.
